name: canvas
description: The canvas: terminals, agents and events on a board without edges, wired output to input. New session → Canvas.

harnesses.title: Shell
harnesses.description: A shell in the workspace, or in a worktree of its own.

cwd.title: Folder
cwd.description: Where it starts, in the workspace; the workspace itself when empty.

harnesses.title: Command…
harnesses.description: A shell that runs a command when it starts: a server, a watcher, the tests.

command.title: Command
command.description: Typed at the shell's first prompt.

cwd.title: Folder
cwd.description: Where it runs, in the workspace; the workspace itself when empty.

harnesses.title: Claude Code
harnesses.description: Anthropic's coding agent in a terminal, told of the canvas through its hooks.

output.title: Output
output.description: What goes along its edges: replies — its answers to messages from the canvas (what you ask it stays with you); all — every answer; explicit — only what it emits.

harnesses.title: Codex
harnesses.description: OpenAI's coding agent in a terminal, told of the canvas through its notify program.

output.title: Output
output.description: What goes along its edges: replies — its answers to messages from the canvas (what you ask it stays with you); all — every answer; explicit — only what it emits.

harnesses.title: OpenCode
harnesses.description: The opencode agent in a terminal; the canvas reads when it is quiet.

sources.title: Manual

sources.title: Timer

text.title: Text
